name: chrona-scheduler-source
description: Source of the Chrona Scheduler control for Power Apps

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-ui run build && pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-control-pcf run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-ui run build && pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-control-pcf exec pcf-scripts build --buildMode production
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-ui run test && pnpm --filter @chrona/scheduler-control-pcf run test:unit
